9.title: Stage 9 (E): take-off at the soma, axon[0] and axon[1] under ramps of 1.1, 11 and 110 pA/ms
9.prediction: The fit's take-off at every recorded point moves less than 1 mV across the three ramps; the approach that results is measured and reported.
9.rejection: A ramp that produces no spike inside the pulse is a no-reading at that rate.
9.amendment: Registered before any ramp was read: the first launch ramped to the 2 nA cap over the whole second and the 1.1 pA/ms run had not finished in 30 minutes (every spike under CVode at nseg 9 costs about a minute); the reading is spike 1, so each input now stops shortly after the expected first spike (--stop-ms 1400, 1120, 1060: ramp maxima 0.42, 1.1 and 2 nA). The aborted run is not counted.
